title: The Free Tool Nobody Installs
premise: Everyone lists the flashy paid AI tools. This flips it: the free Claude Code plugin almost no one installs, and why skipping it is quietly costing people hours every week.
hook:
SPOKEN HOOK: "There's a free plugin sitting in Claude Code right now that 90% of people using it have never touched."
TEXT OVERLAY: "The plugin nobody installs"
VISUAL DIRECTION: Screen recording, cursor hovering over an installed-plugins list, one greyed-out/uninstalled row highlighted in red.
AUDIO NOTE: One sharp UI click sound on the highlight, then silence.
CURIOSITY LOOP: Which plugin is it, and what is it costing me by not having it?
WHY IT WORKS: Investigator contrast — what you don't know vs. what I found — targeted at people who already use the tool, so it feels personally relevant, not generic.
script:
EMOTION TARGET: Surprise/curiosity
HOOK (0-3s): Line above, on a real terminal screen recording — no intro, no face yet.
BODY 1 (context): "Most people install Claude Code, run a few prompts, and stop there." (second-best point — sets the common ground)
BUT: "But the people getting 10x more out of it aren't smarter prompters. They installed one plugin you probably skipped."
BODY 2 (best point): Show the install command live, then a before/after: same task, without the plugin (manual, multi-step) vs. with it (one command, done). Name the plugin on screen as text (Term Branding).
REHOOK: "And that's not even the part that saves the most time."
BODY 3: Show the second-order benefit — e.g. it remembers context across sessions, so you stop re-explaining your codebase every morning.
OUTRO: "One install. Stop re-explaining yourself to your own tools." Atomic takeaway on screen as final text card.
